newsitem.title: UK: Five Brent dates kept, one clocked on Friday-trade.
newsitem.headline: Five Brent dates kept, one clocked on Friday-trade.

text.p: Five of Friday's six Brent cargoes nominated loading dates were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline on Friday but the sixth was left unclaimed, traders said.
BP kept three cargoes, two loading Oct 26-28 and one Oct 28-30, selling the latter for Nov -5 cents to a U.S. bank.
Mobil kept an October 27-29 cargo and Shell UK an October 28-30 loader.
A sixth cargo was five o'clocked and in dispute.
